cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama Senate District 35 since November 2018. He served in the Alabama House of Representatives, District 105, from 2011 to 2018. A Grand Bay farmer, he co-owns Sessions Farm and has served as president of Grand Bay Water Works and Producers Gin Company LLC.
cands.gaps: His birthplace and the year he came to or began living in Alabama are not stated in the sources found. We found no documented bills he sponsored, actions in office or public statements on the issues in this guide, including data centers, homestead taxes, land buying, growth, immigration and workers, policing, guns, abortion, and school choice or teacher pay. We found no documented controversies. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026.
